content: Zidovudine is available in the following formulations: 1. RETROVIR Tablets: Each tablet contains 300 mg of zidovudine. The tablets are white, round, biconvex, and film-coated. One side of the tablet is engraved with GX CW3, while the other side is marked with 300. These tablets are supplied in bottles containing 60 tablets (NDC 49702-214-18). They should be stored at a temperature between 15°C and 25°C (59°F to 77°F). 2. RETROVIR Capsules: Each capsule contains 100 mg of zidovudine. The capsules have a white, opaque cap and body. The cap is printed with Wellcome and a unicorn logo, while the body is marked with Y9C and 100. These capsules are supplied in bottles containing 100 capsules (NDC 49702-211-20). They should be stored at a temperature between 15°C and 25°C (59°F to 77°F) and must be protected from moisture. 3. RETROVIR Syrup: This formulation is a colorless to pale yellow liquid with a strawberry flavor. Each milliliter of the syrup contains 10 mg of zidovudine. It is supplied in 240 mL bottles with child-resistant caps (NDC 49702-212-48). The syrup should be stored at a temperature between 15°C and 25°C (59°F to 77°F).
